# Donadomains — Full API Reference

> Domain search aggregator that compares prices across 8+ registrars and provides in-depth domain intelligence. Find the cheapest place to buy any domain, or look up who owns it.

Base URL: https://donadomains.xyz
Docs: https://donadomains.xyz/docs
Auth: None required (free, unauthenticated)

---

## Endpoint 1: Domain Search

GET /api/search?q={keyword}

Searches domain availability across 8+ registrars (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Dynadot, Hover, Name.com, Hostinger, Squarespace, Spaceship) in real-time. Returns live pricing with direct purchase links from each registrar, and automatically marks the cheapest option.

### Parameters

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description |
|--------|--------|----------|-------------|
| q      | string | Yes      | Search keyword (e.g. "startup") or full domain (e.g. "startup.io"). A bare keyword searches across all TLDs that registrars support. |
| stream | string | No       | Set to "true" for Server-Sent Events streaming. Omit for a single JSON response. |

### JSON Response (default)

Waits for all registrars to respond (typically 5-10 seconds), then returns a single JSON object.

```
GET /api/search?q=example
```

Response shape:
```json
{
  "keyword": "example",
  "tld": null,
  "results": [ DomainResult, ... ],
  "sources": [ SourceStatus, ... ]
}
```

If the query includes a TLD (e.g. "example.io"), the `tld` field will be ".io" and that exact domain will be prioritized in results.

### Streaming Response (stream=true)

Results arrive progressively via Server-Sent Events as each registrar completes.

```
GET /api/search?q=example&stream=true
```

Each SSE message has a `data:` prefix containing JSON. Event types:

- `init` — Sent first. Contains `registrars` array listing names of registrars being queried.
- `batch` — Sent each time a registrar completes. Contains `registrar` (name), `registrarStatus` ("ok" or "failed"), `results` (full merged results so far), `sourceStatuses` (all sources so far).
- `rdap_update` — Sent for each taken domain with registration details. Contains `domain` and `registration` object.
- `rdap_done` — Sent after all RDAP lookups finish.
- `complete` — Final event. Stream closes after this.

### DomainResult

| Field        | Type          | Description |
|--------------|---------------|-------------|
| domain       | string        | Fully qualified domain name (e.g. "example.com") |
| available    | boolean       | Whether the domain is available for registration |
| tld          | string        | TLD including dot (e.g. ".com") |
| matchType    | string?       | "exact" if the domain matches the keyword + a standard TLD, "similar" otherwise |
| buyLinks     | BuyLink[]?    | Purchase links from registrars with pricing (available domains only) |
| registerUrl  | string?       | Direct URL to register at the cheapest registrar |
| registration | object?       | Registration details for taken domains (see below) |

### BuyLink

| Field           | Type    | Description |
|-----------------|---------|-------------|
| name            | string  | Registrar name (e.g. "GoDaddy", "Namecheap") |
| url             | string  | Direct purchase URL — takes user to checkout |
| price           | string? | Formatted price (e.g. "$1.08/yr") |
| priceNum        | number? | Numeric price for sorting/comparison |
| renewalPrice    | string? | Formatted renewal price (e.g. "$9.08/yr") |
| renewalPriceNum | number? | Numeric renewal price |
| isCheapest      | boolean?| True if this is the cheapest option across all registrars |

### Registration (for taken domains)

| Field     | Type   | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| registrar | string?| Name of the registrar holding the domain |
| created   | string?| Creation date (ISO 8601) |
| expires   | string?| Expiration date (ISO 8601) |
| status    | string[]?| ICANN status codes |

### SourceStatus

| Field  | Type   | Description |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| name   | string | Registrar name |
| status | string | "ok" or "failed" |
| count  | number | Number of domains returned by this source |

### Error Responses

| Status | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| 400    | Missing or invalid `q` parameter |
| 500    | Internal server error |

### Example: JavaScript

```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://donadomains.xyz/api/search?q=myproject");
const data = await res.json();

const available = data.results.filter(r => r.available);
const cheapest = available
  .flatMap(r => r.buyLinks ?? [])
  .find(l => l.isCheapest);

console.log(`${available.length} domains available`);
console.log(`Cheapest: ${cheapest?.name} at ${cheapest?.price}`);
console.log(`Buy: ${cheapest?.url}`);
```

### Example: Python

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://donadomains.xyz/api/search", params={"q": "myproject"})
data = res.json()

available = [r for r in data["results"] if r["available"]]
for domain in available:
    for link in domain.get("buyLinks", []):
        if link.get("isCheapest"):
            print(f"{domain['domain']} — {link['price']} at {link['name']}")
            print(f"Buy: {link['url']}")
```

---

## Endpoint 2: Domain Info

GET /api/domain/{domain}

Returns comprehensive domain intelligence for a single domain. Queries RDAP (registration data) and DNS-over-HTTPS (nameservers, resolution status) in parallel. Falls back to who.is scraping for domains with sparse RDAP data.

### Path Parameters

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description |
|--------|--------|----------|-------------|
| domain | string | Yes      | Fully qualified domain name (e.g. "example.com"). Must be lowercase alphanumeric with dots/hyphens, ending in a valid TLD. |

### Response: DomainIntel

| Field          | Type     | Description |
|----------------|----------|-------------|
| domain         | string   | The normalized domain queried |
| registered     | boolean  | Whether the domain is currently registered |
| status         | string[]?| ICANN domain status codes |
| created        | string?  | Creation date (ISO 8601) |
| updated        | string?  | Last updated date (ISO 8601) |
| expires        | string?  | Expiration date (ISO 8601) |
| registrar      | string?  | Name of the registrar |
| registrarUrl   | string?  | Registrar website URL |
| registrant     | string?  | Name of the registrant (often redacted for privacy) |
| organization   | string?  | Registrant organization |
| contactEmail   | string?  | Registrant contact email (only shown when genuinely from registrant, not registrar abuse desk) |
| contactPhone   | string?  | Registrant contact phone |
| contactAddress | string?  | Registrant address |
| nameservers    | string[]?| Authoritative nameservers |
| dnssec         | string?  | DNSSEC status (e.g. "signedDelegation") |
| sources        | string[] | Data sources used: "rdap", "dns", "who.is" |
| timing         | object   | Milliseconds spent per source (e.g. { "rdap": 342, "dns": 87 }) |

### Error Responses

| Status | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| 400    | Invalid domain format |
| 504    | Request timed out (10 second limit) |
| 500    | Internal server error |

### Example: JavaScript

```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://donadomains.xyz/api/domain/github.com");
const intel = await res.json();

console.log(intel.registered);   // true
console.log(intel.registrar);    // "MarkMonitor Inc."
console.log(intel.expires);      // "2025-10-09T18:20:50Z"
console.log(intel.nameservers);  // ["dns1.p08.nsone.net", ...]
```

### Example: Python

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://donadomains.xyz/api/domain/github.com")
intel = res.json()

if intel["registered"]:
    print(f"Registrar: {intel.get('registrar')}")
    print(f"Expires: {intel.get('expires')}")
    print(f"Nameservers: {intel.get('nameservers')}")
else:
    print("Domain is available for registration")
```

---

## How It Works

1. **Registrar Discovery**: When you search, we scrape 8+ registrar search pages in parallel. Each registrar returns domains across the TLDs they support — no hardcoded list.

2. **DNS Verification**: We DNS-check every domain the registrars return using Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS. This gives authoritative available/taken status (registrars sometimes disagree).

3. **Price Aggregation**: For available domains, we merge pricing from all registrars and mark the cheapest option with `isCheapest: true`.

4. **RDAP Enrichment**: For taken domains, we fetch registration details (registrar, owner, expiry, nameservers) from RDAP — the modern, HTTP-based replacement for WHOIS.

## Notes

- No authentication required
- Response time: ~5-10 seconds for search (registrar scraping is the bottleneck), ~1-2 seconds for domain info
- Prices are live — scraped from registrar websites in real-time, not cached
- Privacy: owner contact details only shown when the registrant hasn't opted into privacy protection
